National Take Your Parents to Lunch Day is an annual event in the United States that typically takes place on the second Wednesday in October. The day is dedicated to encouraging parents or guardians to visit their children's school during lunchtime, share a meal, and spend quality time together.
Purpose of the Day:
• Foster stronger connections between tamilies and schools.
• Give parents a chance to see what their children are eating at school.
• Encourage healthy eating habits and open conversations about nutrition.
• Help parents build relationships with school staft and fellow parents.

How it's celebrated:
• Many schools invite parents or guardians to join their children for lunch in the cafeteria.
• Schools may host special programs, offer tours, or provide information about their lunch and nutrition policies.
• It serves as a platform for parents to give feedback or suggestions about school meals.
National Take Your Parents to Lunch Day is part of wider efforts to promote parental involvement in schools and develop healthier school environments for children.
